summary: A 3D character animation generated via Claude Opus 5.5 showing a round cow running on its udder teats along a track and jumping a hurdle.

post.originalText:
What the f*ck is this drug trip

I told Opus 5.5 to make a cow that runs. This is what it gave me for $6.80.

It runs on its f*cking udder. Four teats as legs. Then it jumps a fence in slow motion and lands like a pancake.
